q: Thou hast made us for thyself, O Lord, and our heart is restless until it finds its rest in thee.
All shall be well, and all shall be well, and all manner of thing shall be well.

We ought not to be weary of doing little things for the love of God, who regards not the greatness of the work, but the love with which it is performed.
s: The Practice of the Presence of God

q: The time of business does not with me differ from the time of prayer.
s: The Practice of the Presence of God

q: Faith is a living, daring confidence in God's grace, so sure and certain that a man could stake his life on it a thousand times.
I felt my heart strangely warmed.
Expect great things from God; attempt great things for God.
Prayer does not fit us for the greater work; prayer is the greater work.
Men are God's method.
Humility is the only soil in which the graces root.
Let nothing disturb you, let nothing frighten you; all things are passing; God never changes.
If I could hear Christ praying for me in the next room, I would not fear a million enemies.
For every look at self, take ten looks at Christ.
O Lord, thou knowest how busy I must be this day: if I forget thee, do not thou forget me.
Be still, my soul: the Lord is on thy side.
Great is thy faithfulness, O God my Father; there is no shadow of turning with thee.
Whatever my lot, thou hast taught me to say, it is well, it is well with my soul.

q: I once was lost, but now am found, was blind, but now I see.
Come, thou Fount of every blessing, tune my heart to sing thy grace.

O Love that wilt not let me go, I rest my weary soul in thee.
s: O Love That Wilt Not Let Me Go

q: What a friend we have in Jesus, all our sins and griefs to bear!
s: What a Friend We Have in Jesus

q: Nothing in my hand I bring, simply to thy cross I cling.
Be thou my vision, O Lord of my heart.
s: tr. Mary Byrne, versified Eleanor Hull

q: Man proposes, but God disposes.
Be not angry that you cannot make others as you wish them to be, since you cannot make yourself as you wish to be.
To be trusted is a greater compliment than being loved.
The heart has its reasons which reason knows nothing of.
He that is down needs fear no fall, he that is low, no pride.
I preached as never sure to preach again, and as a dying man to dying men.
Love so amazing, so divine, demands my soul, my life, my all.
s: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross

q: Amazing love! How can it be that thou, my God, shouldst die for me?
Have patience with all things, but chiefly have patience with yourself.
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty! Early in the morning our song shall rise to thee.
